test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the type of brazed joint shown below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23d2b2ed98dc24a6be4a58ed30e6db4e59aca547bac06005816336abff38731c.png]
solution:
__**Concept**__

From the given figure:

 
• Two flat plates overlap each other directly.
 
• There is no step, offset, or jog in either plate.
 
• The brazing filler metal is applied in the overlapping region.

This configuration is characteristic of a simple lap joint.
